source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F, Item 7.A major shareholders
source.quote: According to Toyota's register of shareholders, as of March 31, 2025, there were 1,184,935 holders of common stock of record worldwide.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "Asia;Japan;Toyota Motor Corp;Consumer Discretionary;43181517199;3802076822;1.2%;1.2%". NBIM: Matched to Toyota Motor Corp (7203), not Toyota Industries. CalPERS: its Form 13F for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 lists no shares or ADRs of Toyota. Holders of record: Worldwide holders of record per Toyota's own share register (not the U.S.-only ADS count also given).
